welcome.title: Tezzet
welcome.subtitle: Tezos Wallet
welcome.description: A fast, lightweight, and secure wallet for the Tezos blockchain.

createWallet.title: Create New Wallet
createWallet.description: We will generate a new wallet with a 24-word recovery phrase. Make sure to write it down and store it securely.
createWallet.recoveryWarning: Write down these 24 words in order and store them in a secure location. Never share them with anyone.
createWallet.confirmBackup: I Have Saved My Recovery Phrase
createWallet.backupConfirmedMessage: Make sure you have saved your recovery phrase in a secure location. You will need it to recover your wallet.

importWallet.title: Import Wallet
importWallet.description: Enter your 12 or 24 word recovery phrase to restore your wallet.
importWallet.label: Recovery Phrase
importWallet.invalidPhraseMessage: Please enter a valid 12 or 24 word recovery phrase.
importWallet.importError: Failed to import wallet. Please check your recovery phrase.

sendScreen.title: Send XTZ
sendScreen.invalidAddressMessage: Please enter a valid Tezos address.
sendScreen.invalidQRMessage: The scanned QR code does not contain a valid Tezos address.

receiveScreen.title: Receive XTZ
receiveScreen.description: Share your address or scan the QR code to receive XTZ.

scanner.permissionRequired: Camera access is required to scan QR codes.
